image-generation.prompt-elaborate:
A 45-year-old Italian woman (use Elena Higgsfield reference) holding a summer dress on a hanger, looking at it with a direct knowing expression - she is showing it to camera as if saying "you know this one". NOT contemplative cinematic. NOT closeted melancholy. She is in a clean modern bedroom or near a closet, neutral background, holding the dress slightly raised in front of her body. The dress is a simple summer dress (cream or sage), recognizable as a "going out summer dress".
She wears casual home clothes (athletic top + leggings or simple t-shirt). Bright clean modern home setting, soft natural daylight, NEUTRAL white-balanced color (NOT warm golden Mediterranean grading). Her expression: direct, eyebrow slightly raised, "I see you, I have one too" coach energy.
CRITICAL STYLE: PRACTICAL coach moment, clean modern photography, NOT editorial cinematic. Real Italian woman 45, real body, no retouching. Composition: subject center, dress visible in frame, plenty of clean negative space top and bottom for brand overlay.
image-generation.negative-prompt: cinematic editorial, Sofia Coppola, Guadagnino, golden hour Mediterranean, contemplative quiet moment, walk-in closet warm wood luxury, dress fitting drama, model thin, fashion editorial, Vogue mood, instagram filter, beauty filter, makeup heavy, sad regret pose
